name: Transparent double 6 hook adhesive hanger for kitchen and bathroom
description:
POWERFUL ADHESIVE HOOKS
These adhesive hooks are made up of PVC which can hold 10Kg weight capacity and yellow stain resistance, rust and be able to withstand high compression or heavy loads.
ENABLE FOR YOUR SPARE SPACE
These 6 hook hangers volume is small, the weight is light, the force of traction is big. Our seamless adhesive hooks excellence on simple in frame, easy to handle, good capability and low cost.
STRONG ADHESIVE
This wall hanging hooks contains excellent toughness which completely covered by the adhesive layer. These trackless self adhensive transparent hooks can easily attached to ceramic tiles, smooth non-porous windows, glass, mirrors, metal, fiberglass or any other clean, slick, non-porous surface.
REMOVABLE AND RESUABLE
Easy to use and leave no residue on surface.
DAMAGE-FREE MOUNTING ON DRYWALL 
No Drilling, No Screws, No Holes, No Glue. Perfect for Tile, Porous and other smooth surfaces. Eg: glass, ceramic tile and marble, etc. Ideal for hanging showers or bathroom accessories on tools in bathroom or kitchen appliances and tile backsplash.
